IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Wallace, Hinkle, Haigh and Holmquist

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales tax exemption for trail grooming.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales tax exemption for trailgrooming on private and stateowned land; and adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of trailgrooming services to the state of Washington or private owners of land.For the purposes of this section, "trail grooming" means the activityof snow compacting, snow redistribution, or snow removal on stateownedor privatelyowned trails.
